title: Worgfang
summary: A dagger that gives goblins Disadvantage when attacking the wielder.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple one-handed Light, Finesse, Thrown and Dippable dagger. 5 ft melee. Hit for 1d4 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity.
fields.Goblin’s Undoing: Goblins have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the wielder.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action with proficiency once per Short Rest. Deal melee weapon damage. A Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. While affected, successful attacks deal 2 extra Piercing, or damage sources deal 2 extra of their own type in Honour Mode. Healing removes it.
fields.Acquisition: Bone pile in a Worg Pens cell (386, −17).

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
